# Developer Toolkit

> > Developer Toolkit is a comprehensive resource for AI-powered development with Codex, covering installation, workflows, and agent skills across CLI, App, IDE, and Cloud surfaces.

The site focuses on helping developers leverage Codex for AI-assisted coding across multiple platforms including VS Code, Cursor, JetBrains IDEs, and Windsurf. It provides practical guides for Git workflows, parallel agents, and reusable AI skills for frontend frameworks like React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, and Svelte.

## Key Topics

- Codex
- AI coding agents
- Codex CLI
- Codex App
- VS Code
- Cursor
- Git workflows
- Agent skills
- Frontend development
- React
- Installation and setup
- Workflow automation
- JetBrains IDEs
- Windsurf
- Persistent context

## Getting Started with Codex

- [Getting Started with Codex](https://developertoolkit.ai/en/codex/quick-start/): Quick-start guide for OpenAI Codex setup across CLI, App, IDE, and Cloud
- [Installation](https://developertoolkit.ai/en/codex/quick-start/installation/): Install Codex App, CLI, and IDE extension on macOS, Linux, and Windows

## Codex Workflows and Techniques

- [20 Real-World Codex Scenarios](https://developertoolkit.ai/en/codex/lessons/): Battle-tested Codex workflows with parallel agents and worktrees
- [Advanced Codex Techniques](https://developertoolkit.ai/en/codex/advanced-techniques/): Expert Codex techniques for App, CLI, Cloud, and IDE surfaces

## AI Agent Skills and Automation

- [Introduction to Agent Skills](https://developertoolkit.ai/en/shared-workflows/skills-ecosystem/): Intro to reusable AI agent skills for tools, frameworks, and workflows
- [Best Skills for Frontend Development](https://developertoolkit.ai/en/shared-workflows/skills-ecosystem/top-skills-frontend/): Top AI skills for React, Next.js, Vue, Angular, and Svelte development
